about: Conversations with the rubric a teacher would expect (1-5 each), for scripts/eval-conversation-rubric.mjs. Written by Claude as a first calibration set (CRITICAL_REVIEW.md §14); to be checked by an English teacher. A result within 1 of the expected value counts as agreement.

messages.content: Hi! What can I get for you today?
coffee
Sure. What size would you like?
yes
Small, medium or large?
big
A large coffee. Anything else?
no thank
Hello, what brings you in today?
i have pain head
I am sorry to hear that. How long have you had the headache?
two day
Do you have a fever?
i dont know the fever maybe yes hot
Have you taken any medicine?
no medicine i am not take
Good evening, welcome. Do you have a reservation?
yes i have reservation name cohen
Thank you, Mr. Cohen. Two nights, is that right?
yes two night
Would you like breakfast included?
what time is breakfast
From seven to ten in the morning.
ok yes i want breakfast please
Hi, can I help you find something?
yes i search the milk without lactose
Lactose-free milk is in aisle four, next to the yogurt.
thank you and where is the bread it is fresh today
The bread is at the back. It came in this morning.
good i need also eggs for my children they like very much
Eggs are right next to the milk.
ok thanks you very helpful
You look lost. Can I help?
yes please where is the train station
Go straight and turn left at the bank. It is about ten minutes.
is it far to walk
Not really, but you can take bus number five.
i will walk it is nice weather
Good idea. Enjoy your walk!
thank you have a nice day
Tell me a little about yourself.
i work five years in a software company as a tester i check the apps before they go to customers
Why do you want to leave your current job?
i want to learn more things and grow maybe to be a developer
What is your biggest strength?
i am very careful with details and i find bugs that other people miss
And a weakness?
sometimes i am too slow because i check everything two times
How is everything with your meal?
to be honest the steak is a little cold and i ordered it medium but it's well done
I am so sorry. Would you like me to bring you a new one?
yes please but can you make it fast because we have a movie at nine
Of course. I will ask the kitchen to hurry.
thanks and could we get more water meanwhile
Right away.
great i appreciate it
Hi, I just moved in next door. I am Sam.
oh welcome i'm dana nice to meet you where did you move from
From Haifa. I got a new job here in Tel Aviv.
cool what do you do
I am a nurse at the hospital.
wow that's hard work if you need anything like sugar or help with the boxes just knock
That is very kind of you.
no problem the building is quiet you will like it here
The price for the full package is five thousand dollars.
that's more than we budgeted for is there any flexibility if we sign a two year contract
We could offer ten percent off for two years.
i was hoping for something closer to fifteen especially since we'd be paying upfront
Upfront payment changes things. Twelve percent?
twelve works if you throw in the onboarding sessions for our team
I think we can do that.
great then let's put it in writing and i'll get it approved by friday
So, what do you think of the apartment?
it's bright and the layout is nice but the kitchen looks like it hasn't been renovated in years
The owner is planning to replace the cabinets.
would that happen before we move in because we can't live with a construction site
It should be done by the end of the month.
and are utilities included in the rent or do we pay them separately
Water is included, electricity is separate.
okay that's reasonable could you send me the contract so i can go over it
Do you think remote work is here to stay?
i think hybrid is here to stay fully remote tends to erode the informal knowledge sharing that happens when people bump into each other
But many people say they are more productive at home.
they may well be for focused individual work the catch is that collaboration and mentoring suffer and those costs only show up months later
So what would you recommend to a company?
i'd anchor a couple of days a week around meetings and pairing and leave the rest for deep work otherwise you get the worst of both worlds
That sounds balanced.
it's a compromise but a deliberate one rather than whatever happens by default
Thank you for calling. How can I help?
i've been charged twice for the same order and i'd like the duplicate payment reversed
I can see two charges. The second should drop off automatically.
i was told that last week as well and it's still there so i'd rather you issue a refund now than wait and see
Understood. I will process a refund today.
thank you could you also email me a confirmation so i have something in writing
Of course, you will get it within the hour.
perfect i appreciate you sorting it out

examples.note: The fluent lines were read from suggestions and must not raise the scores.

messages.content: Hi! What can I get for you?
I would like a large cappuccino with oat milk, please.
Sure. Anything to eat?
cake
We have chocolate or cheesecake.
Could I have a slice of cheesecake to take away?
Of course. For here or to go?
go

examples.note: The translated line must not count toward the scores.

messages.content: Hello, how can I help you?
i need something for the throat
Is it a sore throat or a cough?
I have a dry cough that keeps me awake at night.
This syrup helps with a dry cough.
how much is
Thirty-five shekels.
ok i take
Where are you thinking of traveling this summer?
I want to go to Italy with my wife, maybe Rome and Florence.
Great choice. How long will you stay?
Around ten days. We don't like to hurry.
Will you rent a car?
No, I think the train is more easy between the cities.
That is true, the trains are very good.
Also we want to eat a lot of pasta, it is the main reason.

examples.note: Turns saved before sources existed; all count as the student's.

messages.content: Have you seen any good movies lately?
yeah i watched a thriller last weekend that kept me on the edge of my seat
What was it about?
a journalist who uncovers a scandal and slowly realizes her own editor is involved
Did you like the ending?
not really it felt rushed like they ran out of budget in the last twenty minutes
That happens a lot.
still i'd recommend it the acting alone is worth it
Welcome! Would you like to sign up for a membership?
yes please
Monthly or yearly?
monthly
Do you want classes too, like yoga or spinning?
yoga is good
Great. When would you like to start?
tomorrow morning

examples.note: Typical Hebrew-speaker errors: word order, missing articles, 'I am agree'.

messages.content: How can I help you today?
i want to open account of savings for my son he is ten
Sure. We have an account with a good interest rate for children.
how much is the interest and there is a fee every month
Two percent a year, and no monthly fee.
ok i am agree it sound good
I just need his ID and yours.
i bring it tomorrow because now i don't have with me

examples.note: Strong own turns; one line from a suggestion that shouldn't matter.

messages.content: Where are we with the release?
we're mostly on track the one blocker is the payment integration which is waiting on the vendor's sandbox
Can we release without it?
technically yes but we'd be shipping a checkout that can't take money which kind of defeats the purpose
Fair point. What do you suggest?
Let's escalate to their account manager today.
And if they don't respond?
then we slip by a week and use the time to tighten up the error handling we've been putting off

examples.note: Mostly Hebrew words and single English words.

messages.content: Where would you like to go?
airport
Which terminal?
terminal שלוש
Terminal three. Is this your first time here?
no understand
No problem. We will be there in twenty minutes.
ok
